definitions.gloss: fresh start; new beginning; restart; starting over
definitions.explanation: Beginning again after a setback, failure, or major change in life circumstances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{再出発|さいしゅっぱつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Make a fresh start in a new place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{再出発|さいしゅっぱつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決意|けつい}した→決意する：28116_ketsuisuru⟧。
examples.english: After the divorce, she resolved to make a new start in life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{倒産|とうさん}した→倒産する：26990_tousansuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{再出発|さいしゅっぱつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: The company went bankrupt, but he made a fresh start together with his colleagues.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ (again, re-) and ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧ (departure, start). Emphasizes starting over with determination after adversity.

USAGE:
Often used in life-changing contexts — after divorce, job loss, illness, or disaster. Carries an encouraging, forward-looking tone. Can also be used more literally for restarting a journey or trip.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再出発|さいしゅっぱつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to make a fresh start
- {再出発|さいしゅっぱつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧ — to achieve a new beginning
- {再出発|さいしゅっぱつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決意|けつい}する→決意する：28116_ketsuisuru⟧ — to resolve to start over
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{再出発|さいしゅっぱつ} — a fresh start in life

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出直|でなお}し→出直す：06346_denaosu⟧ — starting over, redo; more casual, implies correcting a mistake
- やり{直|なお}し — doing over; redoing something from scratch
- {再起|さいき} — comeback, recovery; rising again after failure
